grading.formula: EV  =  p_recover × (amount + h·D)  −  p_revoke × D(1−h)  −  fatigue  −  cost
terms: Action head — probability this episode ends recovered.
Revocation head — probability this action itself loses the mandate.
What one recovery is worth: the cycle, plus the churn it prevents.
What a revocation costs beyond the churn that was coming anyway.
The externality this contact imposes on every later contact.
Rail fee or channel cost, priced on the rail it presents on.
